summary: A family loses its home when the local bank closes.
realLife: A narrator said that when the local bank closed in the 1930s his parents lost their little home and the family was put out.
sources: St. Louis Fed, The Great Depression interview series, McIntyre on bank closings: https://www.stlouisfed.org/the-great-depression/curriculum/interviews-mcintyre-5
inGame: `event:housing.eviction` (the nearest record to a foreclosure). `needs:` a bank closing that causes it.

turns.pulledBy: the household's savings were not in the bank
turns.writesBack: the line says the family was spared

turns.pulledBy: a relative or friend with room on the record
